clue.text: List of items to finish in the oven

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other, the finishing word within the cooker

parts.note: an Aga is a well-known brand of range cooker
to finish is to end

explanation.surface: A recipe direction to complete some dishes by baking them.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy cast-iron range cooker found in many British country kitchens; 'finish in the oven' looks like a cooking instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the itemised list of business for a meeting.

clue.text: Contract given to a composer

parts.note: Frank Bridge was an English composer, Britten's teacher

explanation.surface: A composer is handed a contract to write something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contract' is the verb, to shorten, not a legal agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten or condense it, to contract it.

clue.text: Peel gets cross, upset and put out

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: a cross is the letter X

explanation.surface: A man named Peel gets angry and annoyed and is thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to eject or throw out, the same as to put out.

clue.text: What's cast by artist who knows how to feed

parts.note: a die is something cast, or thrown, in games
Titian was the Venetian Renaissance painter

explanation.surface: A painting by an old master shows a nutrition expert.
explanation.definitionFit: A dietitian is an expert in nutrition who advises on what people should eat.

clue.text: Supposed to be set in the grass

indicators.note: set in tells us one piece is planted inside the other, like something placed among the stems

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wetlands
to be set reads as to be put, placed in position

explanation.surface: Something is meant to be planted among the grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Reputed and supposed both mean generally believed to be so, a synonym pair.

clue.text: Popularity lists for sailors?

definitions.meaning: in the Royal Navy ... are ordinary seamen, not officers

explanation.definitionFit: Ratings are both viewing-figure charts and naval seamen below officer rank.

clue.text: Assured fact that may have to be corrected?

definitions.meaning: evidence that establishes something as true

definitions.text: that may have to be corrected?
definitions.meaning: a printed trial copy checked for errors before publication

explanation.definitionFit: Proof is conclusive evidence, and also a printer's trial sheet for correction.

clue.text: Growth of Grahame's character's instrument?

parts.note: Toad of Toad Hall is from The Wind in the Willows by Kenneth Grahame
a tool is an instrument

explanation.surface: Asking what instrument a children's book character uses.
explanation.definitionFit: A toadstool is a fungus, something that grows from the ground.

clue.text: Time's not up in Ohio

parts.note: a day is a period of time

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word reads from bottom to top, reversed

explanation.surface: Time has not run out in an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Dayton is a city located in the state of Ohio, so it is a place found there.

clue.text: European nearly related, but not quite

indicators.note: nearly means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: germane means relevant, related to the matter

explanation.surface: Someone from Europe is almost kin, but not quite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not quite' merely echoes the trimming signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A German is a person from Germany, so a European.

clue.text: Regret about a lot of leisure, as artists do

indicators.note: about tells us the regret word goes around the other piece

parts.note: to regret is to repent

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all, so the leisure word loses its last letter

parts.note: leisure is rest

explanation.surface: Someone regrets spending too much time idle, as artists are said to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot of' trims REST to RES. The definition is a verb phrase: artists represent, or depict, their subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: Artists represent things: they depict them in paint or other media.

clue.text: Love to diversify with reproductive organ?

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
to diversify is to vary

explanation.surface: A suggestion that love benefits from variety.
explanation.definitionFit: The ovary is the female organ that produces eggs.

clue.text: Food store hard to find in eastern capital?

indicators.note: to find in tells us the hardness letter is placed inside the shop word

parts.note: a deli is a shop selling prepared foods
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A delicatessen is hard to track down in an Asian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi, home to New Delhi, is India's capital, so an eastern seat of government.

clue.text: Party programme easily seen to come to nothing

parts.note: something easily seen is manifest
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A political party's policies are plainly shown to amount to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A manifesto is the published platform a political party campaigns on.

clue.text: Auntie, say, loses head in high spirits

indicators.note: loses head means the first letter of the family-member word is dropped

parts.note: an aunt is an example of a relative

explanation.surface: A relative is in a jolly mood after decapitation, absurdly.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is a state of great joy, the same as high spirits.

clue.text: Fill a poor mocked victim with embarrassment

indicators.note: embarrassment suggests a confused state, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: An unlucky person is made to blush after being laughed at.
explanation.definitionFit: An April fool is someone tricked by a prank on the first of April.

clue.text: Models may be overhauled, but not often

indicators.note: an overhaul is a rebuilding, so the letters are taken apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: Model cars or machines might get a rebuild, but rarely.
explanation.definitionFit: Seldom is an adverb meaning rarely, the same as not often.

clue.text: A wreath doubtless required, but in no hurry

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers
doubtless means surely

explanation.surface: A funeral wreath is surely needed, but there is no rush.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisurely means unhurried, done at a relaxed pace.

clue.text: To some extent unprepared, perhaps, for a marital contract

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters taken might be arranged otherwise
to some extent means only part of the next word is used, its tail dropped

explanation.surface: Someone is partly unready for a wedding agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To some extent' drops ARED, leaving UNPREP; 'perhaps' rearranges those six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A prenup is short for a prenuptial agreement settling assets before a marriage.

clue.text: Could Wodehouse be right as performer on pipes?

parts.note: Plum was the nickname of the comic writer P. G. Wodehouse
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking whether a comic novelist would suit a musical role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performer on pipes' is a joke: the tradesman works on water pipes, not organ pipes.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumber works on pipes, fitting and repairing them, so performs on them in a playful sense.

clue.text: Leading sniper did his work, being good at it

indicators.note: leading picks the front letter of the next word

parts.note: a sniper's work is killing, so he killed

explanation.surface: A top marksman did his job and so proved his ability.
explanation.definitionFit: Skilled means expert or able, the same as being good at something.

clue.text: Brook, quiet at first, took on a high note

indicators.note: at first says the quiet piece comes before the stream word

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
a rill is a small brook

explanation.surface: A stream, silent to begin with, rose to a high pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrill describes a piercing high-pitched sound, and as a noun such a sound itself.

clue.text: Appliance for the unsound? If dead, a mistake

indicators.note: a mistake gets things in the wrong order, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A gadget for the unwell is pointless if you are dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A deaf aid is a hearing aid, a device for those who cannot hear sounds.

clue.text: Shape departed at length

parts.note: ob. is short for obiit, Latin for died, on gravestones
of great length means long

explanation.surface: A figure left after a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblong is a rectangle with unequal sides, a geometric shape.

clue.text: Mount a siege to join society?

definitions.meaning: to mount a siege is to besiege or surround a town
read whimsically as be a leaguer, a member of a league or society

explanation.definitionFit: Beleaguer means to lay siege to; the second reading treats it as be plus leaguer, a league member.

clue.text: Shaft, thin, without head but with head

indicators.note: without head means the first letter of the slim word is removed

parts.note: thin means narrow

explanation.surface: A slender rod, first headless, then with a head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but with head' is a joke: the result, a shaft for a bow, does have a head.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrow is a shaft shot from a bow; shaft is an old word for it.

clue.text: Shadow causing some encumbrance

indicators.note: some means a part of the next word supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A shadow that gets in the way of things.
explanation.definitionFit: The umbra is the darkest central part of a shadow, especially in an eclipse.

clue.text: Growth of scripture teaching among lawyers?

indicators.note: among says the teaching letters go inside the lawyers word

parts.note: the Bar is the collective name for barristers
RI is religious instruction, a British school subject

explanation.surface: Religious lessons spreading among the legal profession.
explanation.definitionFit: A briar is a thorny bush, a plant that grows wild.

clue.text: Hum of old bishop at older city

parts.note: Odo of Bayeux was a medieval bishop, half-brother of William the Conqueror
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: A medieval churchman came from an even more ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hum' is the British slang sense of a bad smell, not a musical sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Hum in British slang is a smell, usually an unpleasant one, so a synonym.

clue.text: In some degree the whole of Ireland can be seen dancing

indicators.note: in tells us the other pieces sit inside the degree letters

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts degree
the whole of is all
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: To some extent all of Ireland may be spotted dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a little cryptic: a ballerina is someone who can be seen dancing, so the phrase describes her.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina is a female ballet dancer, someone often seen performing dances.

clue.text: Regrettable adventure to the abyss with immature backing

parts.note: an abyss is a gulf

indicators.note: backing means the word for immature is written in reverse

parts.note: immature can be raw, as in a raw recruit

explanation.surface: A rash venture taken to the edge of the pit with youthful support.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gulf War of 1990-91 was a military campaign, an adventure in the sense of an exploit.

clue.text: Result of mixed race involving heartless king and wife cut short

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle letters of the royal name

parts.note: Henry is the name of several English kings

indicators.note: cut short drops the final letter of the wife word

parts.note: a new wife is a bride

explanation.surface: A child of mixed parents born to an unloving king and a short-lived wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' leaves HY from HENRY; 'cut short' leaves BRID from BRIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: A hybrid is the offspring of two different breeds or strains.
